DBL celebrates Bangladesh's Victory Day in Ethiopia
2018-12-20T17:18:27+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/arts-entertainment/news/dbl-celebrates-bangladeshs-victory-day-ethiopia-1676431

DBL is constantly involved with multiple sustainability initiatives focusing on various social and environmental aspects. Currently, DBL Group is also operating in Ethiopia under the name of DBL Industries PLC.  Recently, the company celebrated the 48th anniversary of the Victory Day of Bangladesh. A day long programme was held to imbue the people of Ethiopia with the prolific history, culture, and the spirit of the War of Liberation of Bangladesh. Bangladeshi and Ethiopian employees rallied for 3.5 kilometers and reached the factory complex to place the wreaths at the memorial statue.
